regimeSub: SPX -1.8% intraday as AI selloff deepens; Treasury rally extends with 10Y at 4.98% on risk-off bid pre-NFP.
themes: Q3 GDP 3.4% print confirmed per TMGM/Fortune + Sep CPI at 4.0% YoY → stagflation regime persists; Fed Warsh held at 4% Oct FOMC per CNBC but hawkish lean keeps Dec hike odds elevated with core PCE stuck at 3.1%
10Y yield compresses 7bp to 4.98% as tech selloff accelerates Treasury haven bid per Bloomberg → 2s10s at +37bp steepens from month-ago +37bp; real rate at 0.98% as breakevens hold near 4%

Lagarde ECB exit creates EUR policy vacuum per Guardian → EURUSD stable at 1.1177 but downside risk on successor uncertainty; BOK held rates Oct 21 per Reuters with Nov hike now live as Fed stays hawkish
Brent at $109.68 down from $112 as OPEC+ holds Dec targets steady per Straits Times; gold retreats to $3,916 from $4,000 as geopolitical premium fades post-Iran interim deal per Atlantic Council
